{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the definition of 'converted' by checking if it matches 'status'
# If 'converted' is 1 only when 'status' is 'completed', then it's consistent
conversion_consistency = df.groupby('converted')['status'].value_counts().unstack(fill_value=0)
print('Conversion status consistency:')
print(conversion_consistency)"}
